description: Re-skin the Mission Debrief screen with the design tokens (replacing gray/default-blue Tailwind classes and hardcoded chart hex), replace the static learning summary with AstroAssistant.getMissionSummary() (added in FEAT-002), add a shared chart-colors constant, add a branded LoadingScreen, convert all 6 routes to React.lazy + Suspense for code-splitting, opt into React Router v7 future flags, update debrief tests, and do light doc updates. Then run the full final verification (build, all tests 120+, git-diff simulation-untouched check, manual flow reasoning). Depends on FEAT-001..FEAT-004.
steps: src/components/charts/chart-colors.ts: export CHART_COLORS = { oxygen: '#29E6F3', water: '#46E6A0', food: '#FFC93C', energy: '#FF5A5F' } matching accent.orbit/status tokens, plus AXIS/Grid/Tooltip hex constants derived from the design tokens (e.g. grid #243456, axis text #A9B8D4, tooltip bg #121C33/border #3A5180/text #EAF1FA).
src/components/common/LoadingScreen.tsx: branded Suspense fallback — ASTRA wordmark, animated starfield (reduced-motion safe), sr-only 'Loading…'. Small file.

src/features/mission-debrief/MissionDebriefScreen.tsx: re-skin — replace bg-gray-900/800, bg-blue-600, text-gray-*, border-gray-* with space-panel/glass + text.*/border.* tokens. Outcome banner: status.good/warn/crit background + a Phosphor icon + label (never color alone). ResourceChart colors come from CHART_COLORS; axis/grid/tooltip styled with the chart-colors hex. Replace getLearningText with AstroAssistant.getMissionSummary() called in a useEffect via useAstroContext() (FEAT-002); show a loading state then the summary text (keep a sensible fallback while loading). Wrap in AppShell + ScreenTransition. Keep all 7 existing sections and the 'Play Again' button (resetMission + navigate '/'). Instantiate AstroAssistant once (useMemo) like AstroAIPanel does.

src/app/router.tsx: wrap all 6 screens in React.lazy(() => import(...)) and render each inside <Suspense fallback={<LoadingScreen/>}>. Keep all guards — wrap so the guard still runs (e.g. <RequireSetup><Suspense fallback={<LoadingScreen/>}><LazyScreen/></Suspense></RequireSetup>). This splits the bundle (report risk R1).
src/App.tsx: add future={{ v7_startTransition: true, v7_relativeSplatPath: true }} to <BrowserRouter> (report risk R12). MemoryRouter in tests is unaffected.

tests/unit/features/MissionDebriefScreen.test.tsx: keep all 7 existing assertions passing (outcome banner /success|failure/i, score rows incl. final '435', 'No mission data recorded', 'Nominal step', 'No decisions recorded.'). Update any class-name-based assertions; add a check that no 'bg-gray-900' class is present; handle the async learning summary (waitFor/findByText or assert the loading placeholder). The outcome banner text still satisfies the /success|failure/i assertions independent of the async summary.

.kiro/steering/workflow.md: mark R1, R2, R3 (playable slice) progress; set current phase to 'Playful 2D/Glass slice - playable end-to-end'. Lightly update .kiro/specs/astra/tasks.md if it has the relevant rows. Do NOT edit product.md or requirements.md.

Final verification: (1) npm run build exits 0, zero TS errors; note the new bundle sizes (expect multiple smaller chunks vs the 653 KB single-chunk baseline). (2) npm run test -- --run passes (91 existing + new; target 120+). (3) git -C "c:\Users\HP\Desktop\NASA SPACE APPS" diff --name-only shows NO src/simulation/ path. (4) Manually reason the full flow: Onboarding -> Planet -> Crew -> Config -> Start Mission -> Mission Control (Advance Day, resolve an event, ask Astro-AI) -> End Mission -> Debrief — every step works with real simulation data. (5) Reduced-motion toggle works; focus-visible rings visible; no color-only signals.
acceptance_criteria: MissionDebriefScreen uses only design tokens (no bg-gray-*/bg-blue-600/text-gray-* classes) and CHART_COLORS for charts
The learning summary comes from AstroAssistant.getMissionSummary() (async, with a loading state) instead of getLearningText

BrowserRouter has the v7 future flags (no v7 future-flag warnings in test output)
Debrief tests pass (7 existing assertions preserved + token/no-gray assertions + async summary handling)
npm run build exits 0 with split chunks; npm run test -- --run passes 120+; git diff shows no src/simulation/ change
verification: npm run build exits 0 with zero TS errors and shows multiple chunks (smaller per-route than the 653 KB baseline)
